determinations.rationale: No consumer statement was filed; obligation not triggered.
CRA reviewed consumer ledger against furnisher payment history, not relying on automated coding alone.
CRA sent dispute and document image to furnisher on the 3rd business day, within the 5-day window.
Valid dispute of accuracy received directly with identified account, field, and basis.
Completed in 24 calendar days, within 30-day deadline.
Dispute identifies consumer, account, disputed field (30-day late), and basis with supporting ledger.
No direct furnisher dispute in this case; not applicable.
All applicable obligations (trigger, timing, furnisher notice, consideration, treatment, results notice) satisfied.
No frivolous termination invoked; not applicable.
Furnisher investigated and reported results to CRA within 18 days, before the reinvestigation deadline.
No identity theft, mixed file, court order, conflicting docs, missing primary documents, or manual review policy trigger present.
Item verified as accurate after reasonable reinvestigation; status recorded current.
No deletion or reinsertion occurred; not applicable.
Dispute received directly by CRA, not through a reseller; not applicable.
Results mailed with revised report 4 business days after completion, within 5-day window.
